name: Atticus
description: Controls your Mac by voice: hold a hotkey, say a task, and it moves windows, finds files, reads your screen and works in Chrome, on your Claude plan.

skills.name: Window Control
skills.description: Opens apps and arranges windows across displays from a spoken request, with instant commands that skip the AI.

skills.name: File Search
skills.description: Searches your files by what's inside them and opens the match on your other screen, from one spoken request.

skills.name: Screen Reading
skills.description: Reads what is on your screen to answer questions, and lights up the exact spot when you ask where to click.

skills.name: Dictation
skills.description: Types dictated words into any text field, with an optional AI clean-up pass that drops fillers and fixes mishearings.

skills.name: Meeting Copilot
skills.description: Answers questions and takes notes during calls, saving transcripts and recaps locally on your Mac.
